licenses.note: The reference is Minecraft 1.20.6 itself, the game the loader runs, so there is no build to install and nothing to download beyond the game.

deviations.what: On 1.2.5-forge, b1.7.3-stationapi, b1.7.3-ornithe and a1.1.2_01-ornithe, grug:elytra and grug:firework_rocket are plain items: the elytra cannot be equipped, a player cannot glide and the rocket cannot be launched or boost a glide. On 1.20.6-forge they are the reference's own ElytraItem and FireworkRocketItem.
deviations.why: Those loaders predate fall flying, so the glide physics of LivingEntity.travel's isFallFlying branch, a player tick hook, the chest slot and the rocket entity have to be ported into each adapter behind ItemInitContext.set_glider and set_firework_rocket, which supports_gliding reports false for until they are.

deviations.what: On 1.2.5-forge, b1.7.3-stationapi, b1.7.3-ornithe and a1.1.2_01-ornithe, a gliding player keeps the upright body pose in the third-person view and the elytra draws no wings, where 1.20.6 tilts the body and draws the wings. The first-person view is the scope of the ports, because only another player sees a body.
deviations.why: The older loaders have no elytra model and no player-renderer hook yet, and drawing the body and wings only matters once other players can see them, which is the multiplayer work of #36.

deviations.what: On 1.2.5-forge, b1.7.3-stationapi, b1.7.3-ornithe and a1.1.2_01-ornithe, neither item plays a sound. On 1.20.6-forge the equip, glide and rocket sounds are the game's own.
deviations.why: mod_api.json has no sound host function at all, and Alpha, Beta and 1.2.5 predate these sound events, so a port has to ship the .ogg files and a sounds.json of its own as it ships textures.
